description: TikTok API: List a TikTok profile's videos. The public videos of an account, newest first, with views, likes, comments, shares and saves, page by page: follow `pagination.next_cursor`. A private account answers 404. Price: 2 credits per call; failed calls are free. Paginated: pass pagination.next_cursor as `cursor` for the next page (each page is a new call).
name: tiktok_user_videos
title: List a TikTok profile's videos
